target.title: fix(poll): echo the poll question as a visible comment reply
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Agent-created iMessage polls arrive as **bare options with no visible question**. Messages never renders the poll title (payload `item.title`) on the balloon — only the options show. Native polls carry the question in a *separate comment message* whose `reply_to` is the poll guid (the composer's "comment or Send" field), which imsg never populated. So `imsg poll send --question 'X'` stored `X` invisibly and recipients saw only options.

Confirmed against a natively-composed poll in `chat.db`: its `item.title` is **empty**, and the visible question lives in a reply-to-the-poll text message.

## Why This Change Was Made

`--question` was writing to a field Apple leaves empty and never displays, while the field that actually shows the question (the poll comment) had no path. The right model is native's: a poll's caption is a comment that replies to the poll.

## User Impact

`poll send` (CLI) and the `poll.send` RPC now **echo `--question` as a reply comment on the poll** after creation, matching native behavior. Callers pass only the question and the visible caption appears for free, so downstream agents (e.g. OpenClaw) need **no change**. `--comment` overrides the echoed text; `item.title` is still set for agent readback. Best-effort: a comment failure never fails the already-sent poll.

## Evidence

**Before** — a poll sent by the current build has no reply-comment child (bare options):
```
17:33 POLL  text=None  (no child message replies to it)
```

**After** — poll sent by this build auto-creates a reply-comment carrying the question:
```
17:33:11 POLL          guid=A3DDC24F…  (the poll)
17:33:12 text(comment) guid=C615FCEF…  reply_to=A3DDC24F…  ← echoed question
```
Structural match: the echoed comment's `reply_to` **equals the poll guid**, identical to a natively-composed poll's comment.

Live PROOF validation (real Lobster poll, end-to-end through the gateway RPC) to be collected on the deployed build.
